verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs state an automatic captcha stance: built-in auto-CAPTCHA solvers meant to keep tasks running uninterrupted. That is a single marketing-level line with no detail on what happens when solving fails, and the community mention only echoes the marketing. The live-view takeover feature is generic and not documented as a captcha fallback, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented behavior when a captcha cannot be solved (error or status reporting rather than silent failure), a documented human-fallback path for captchas, supported captcha types and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the solving works.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures

citations.quote: Auto-CAPTCHA solvers: Bypass CAPTCHA challenges automatically, allowing for uninterrupted task execution.
